column8: Wed 25 Nov: 3e top sentence: what is guaranteed, what is not and who makes it up is the case readers grasped least (retail readers of structured notes, not funders or judges)
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: never a risk label for the fund's shortfall, give its size and owner; row is a rating-scale result so drop the 54.1% and 51% from prose
Wed 25 Nov: 3e/Table 2: bond-fund readers took bonds as a capital guarantee, so the fund sentence is a correction; retail EU readers, mixed funds
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: set up every term inside 3e; leaflet test so a 12-page reader may link better
Wed 25 Nov: 3e gloss at first use; qualitative, near-twin of row 4 so fold into one checker rule
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: name the protector by what it does not by ticker; FCA drafting choice not a reader test of acronyms
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 shape of consequence then conditions; tested only as a whole summary with the warning
Wed 25 Nov: 3e names a limit only where true; a rule not a reader test so use as checker note only
Wed 25 Nov: 3d make-up clause: one sentence for what the cover does and does not cover; prescribed text, not a reader test
Wed 25 Nov: 3e order: failure first; a comment letter never tested on readers
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: name causes precisely, give consequence once; measures willingness to invest and only the abstract was read
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: no warning frame; the two IPS reasons are exits not threats; EU qualitative leaflets
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: each limit carries its one figure; retail readers, and co-sponsors may differ
Wed 25 Nov: 3e must not read as a disclaimer; advice warnings not limits
Wed 25 Nov: recall is not use is the stored row on what helps reading versus behaviour
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: judges are high-knowledge so strong words will not move them; read only in REP 632 summary, do not cite as read at source
Wed 25 Nov: limits tagged onto good news can backfire; read only via REP 632 and tweets are not a report
Wed 25 Nov: a plain signal phrase opening each limit; secondhand via the SEC study, do not cite
Wed 25 Nov: less boilerplate not more bold for expert readers; accounting disclosures, abstract only
Wed 25 Nov: 3e scenario needs a likelihood word or dated history or readers invent one; pairs with 3c range
Wed 25 Nov: scenarios read as predictions is stored in the PRIIPs version
Wed 25 Nov: 3e consequences in dollars, percentages for causes; stated preference about charges only
Wed 25 Nov: indicative figure heard as definitive restates scenarios read as forecasts, and Q71 rows 10 and 28 on about
Wed 25 Nov: 3e closing line: scope it to what it covers or readers stretch it to nothing can touch it; scale labels not sentences
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 grid versus 3e prose; arms use different question sets so figures not like for like
Wed 25 Nov: never x years in every 20 for any limit; Australian savers, violation is choice consistency not comprehension
Wed 25 Nov: state limits from the downside; digest summary only, near-twin of row 26 and 28
Wed 25 Nov: format moves choices as much as size; choice not comprehension, fold into rows 26 and 32
Wed 25 Nov: 3f: 1 in N makes a risk feel larger so the lead decides if 1 in 31 or about 3 in 100; 3c keeps one denominator
Wed 25 Nov: percent and N in 100 beat 1 in N is part of the review's shared denominator finding
Wed 25 Nov: 3f: 1 in N widens the gap between two risks; one test with no none case, which row 34 inference covers
Wed 25 Nov: 3c and 3e: one denominator per part and one figure per limit; best summary of number formats
Wed 25 Nov: 3c: 91 of 100 will not be heard as 9 in 100 below; say the downside if 3e needs it; product scenarios, retail readers
Wed 25 Nov: 3f inference with no reader test; a lead call, fold with rows 29 and 31
Wed 25 Nov: 3e holds three limits and one hard case; lab students on a short-form disclosure
Wed 25 Nov: cutting words alone will not make 3e understood; insurance choices, not limits
Wed 25 Nov: 3e keeps the reason a fund can pay a little less than its Treasuries; regulators review quote, not a test
Wed 25 Nov: readers skip risk lines that change no decision restates the few-items finding of row 35
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: no generic risk line, specific contextual statements; FCA guidance, builds on stored Q130-027 to Q130-029
Wed 25 Nov: specific beats generic whether listed or in a block; MBA students as stand-ins, 96 people
Wed 25 Nov: self-report of what readers seek; minor support for placing 3e after the range
Wed 25 Nov: two layers of prose and table; stated preference only
Wed 25 Nov: 3e voice: limits stated by the authors raise trust; cancer news readers, not funders or judges
Wed 25 Nov: own mistake or damaging fact first is stored as the workplace version
Wed 25 Nov: candour pays only short term, which suits a one-time judge read; managers over time, so do not lean on it
Wed 25 Nov: specific limit softens later loss of credibility; p = 0.052 and a travel-company risk, so say little of it
Wed 25 Nov: a plain 3e makes limits land harder, so each carries owner and figure; earnings news only
Wed 25 Nov: disclosure not protecting listeners is stored as the stake-disclosure row
Wed 25 Nov: 3e explains only what readers miss and flags nothing; single focus-group quotes, colour only
Wed 25 Nov: Figure 2 axis note; charts not sentences, belongs with the exhibit notes
Wed 25 Nov: checker frame for each 3e limit sentence; Keel inference untested as a whole, never a writer template
